entities.name: Pedro Vicente Fonseca

entities.summary: Pedro "Pecente" Vicente da Fonseca, commonly known as Picente Fonseca, or simply as Picente, is a retired Brazilian professional basketball player. At a height of 1.80 m tall, he played at the point guard position.
